Eliza E. Hewitt: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Eliza E. Hewitt (1851–1920) · Hymn writer

3 hymns on NoteFusion credit Eliza E. Hewitt. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • My Faith Has Found a Resting Place

    My faith has found a resting place,

    Doh is Ab3/4Tune: LANDASSolfa PDF

  • Sunshine in My Soul

    There is sunshine in my soul today,

    Doh is Ab4/4Tune: SUNSHINESolfa PDF

  • When We All Get to Heaven

    Sing the wondrous love of Jesus,

    Doh is C4/4Tune: HEAVENSolfa PDF
